signals.title: USD/NOK — G10 Bilateral Theme + Middle East Escalation
signals.text: Iranian IRGC mine strikes on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz driven by Middle East tensions trigger safe-haven flows into USD while driving broad commodity-FX realignments. USD led G10 with 1W average performance of +2.066% (n=9) while NOK lagged at -1.909% (n=2), generating a 3.975% bilateral spread; high US 10Y yields of 5.15% reinforce dollar supremacy. Fed Governor Jefferson's speech in Tokyo is the catalyst for resolving near-term yield momentum into the Sydney/Tokyo open. Trade bias: Bullish USD/NOK into the open; safe-haven demand and high US yields maintain upside pressure. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo open and Fed Governor Jefferson speech. Risk: Invalidation below Friday close of 9.565 if energy market escalation subsides.

signals.title: EUR/USD — Hawkish Fed Yield Shift vs Crowded Short
signals.text: EUR COT LF net short of -104.0k contracts (pctl 2%) creates squeeze risk, but hawkish Fed speak pushing US 2Y yields to 4.86% maintains heavy downside pressure on EUR/USD. The 146bp SOFR-€STR OIS carry advantage for USD and EUR/USD trading below its SMA20 (1.1174) reinforce the prevailing downtrend despite extreme retail long positioning at 87%. The Sydney/Tokyo open is the catalyst that tests Friday's 1.1028 closing low against surging US Treasury yields. Trade bias: Bearish EUR/USD into the open; yield divergence drives downside toward 1.1000. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo open on Sunday. Risk: Sustained recovery above 1.1086 triggers short-squeeze mechanics in light weekend liquidity.

signals.title: USD/JPY — US Yield Surge vs Extreme Put Skew
signals.text: US 10Y yields rising to 5.15% push USD/JPY toward 159.69, while JPY COT net short of -21.2k contracts (pctl 92%) highlights persistent institutional JPY weakness. The 267bp SOFR-TONA OIS carry differential heavily favors USD, but USD/JPY 1M 25-delta risk reversal at -1.79 signals strong demand for downside put protection. Fed Governor Jefferson's upcoming Tokyo speech is the catalyst for testing whether yield momentum can overcome options hedging demand. Trade bias: Bullish USD/JPY; wide yield differential sustains upside momentum. Catalyst: Fed Governor Jefferson speech at 00:00 UTC. Risk: Drop below 158.22 SMA20 triggers accelerated put option unwinds.

signals.title: AUD/USD — Bullish Positioning Friction vs BEER Undervaluation
signals.text: AUD COT LF net long of +43.5k contracts creates unwinding risk if global risk sentiment deteriorates, even as BEER fair value shows AUD/USD cheap at z = -2.05σ. The 95bp SOFR-AONIA OIS carry advantage favors AUD, but AUD/USD trading extended below its SMA20 (0.6963) reflects dollar dominance. The upcoming RBA meeting on 8 Dec is the catalyst for confirming whether domestic policy support can offset broader dollar strength. Trade bias: Neutral AUD/USD; long positioning unwinds offset structural fair value cheapness. Catalyst: next RBA meeting (mkt: 100% hold priced) on 8 Dec. Risk: Break below Friday close 0.6774 targets 0.6700.
